summary.text: Ronald Muszynski, a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 5th District to Tim Walberg.
Nominated at the party's June 28, 2026 convention, he had appeared on Michigan ballots as a candidate for the state legislature in earlier elections.

paragraphs.text: Ronald Muszynski was the Libertarian candidate for Michigan State Senate District 17 in 2010 and lost the general election to incumbent Randy Richardville (R).
In 2016 he was a candidate in the general election for Michigan House of Representatives District 65, won by incumbent Brett Roberts.
He was the Libertarian candidate for Michigan State Senate District 16 in 2018, losing the general election to incumbent Mike Shirkey (R).
He received 1.0% of the vote to Tim Walberg's 59.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
